mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as the rate approaches zero-bound conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through strengthened economic growth.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve tightening via rising FEDFUNDS, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.0% quarterly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls > 1.0% over 3 months, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate broad economic contraction, driving negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through synchronized sector weakness.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline > 0.5% in 1 quarter, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units signals a housing boom that stimulates consumer spending, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns through wealth effects.
failure_condition: In periods with HOUST > 1200, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
